import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# Access the SVG repo page
url = "https://www.svgrepo.com/vectors/eva-draconis-orion-mind-project-website-banner-symbols-meaning-curved-line"
response = requests.get(url)

if response.status_code == 200:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html')
    
    # Extract the page content
    page_text = soup.get_text()
    print("Page content:")
    print(page_text[:2000])
    
    # Look for any specific mentions of symbol meanings
    if 'meaning' in page_text.lower():
        print("\nFound 'meaning' in content:")
        lines = page_text.split('\n')
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if 'meaning' in line.lower() and len(line.strip()) > 10:
                print(f"Line {i}: {line.strip()}")
    
    # Look for any descriptions or titles
    titles = soup.find_all(['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'title'])
    print(f"\nFound {len(titles)} titles/headings:")
    for title in titles[:5]:
        print(f"  {title.name}: {title.get_text().strip()}")
        
    # Look for any meta descriptions
    meta_desc = soup.find('meta', attrs={'name': 'description'})
    if meta_desc:
        print(f"\nMeta description: {meta_desc.get('content', '')}")
        
else:
    print(f"Failed to access page: {response.status_code}")
